issue.title: Projects tab fails with disk I/O error after full offline sync on physical device
issue.body:
## Summary

After a full offline sync on a physical Android device, opening the **Projects** tab can fail with:

```text
[DBQueries] Error fetching projects with summary
{"error": "[op-sqlite] statement execution error: disk I/O error"}
```

The Projects list stays empty even though post-login sync completes, **My Work** loads normally, and other SQLite reads succeed.

Investigation on device (Redmi Note 9 Pro, user 247, full sync) showed `PRAGMA integrity_check` = **ok** — this is **not** database corruption and not lack of free disk space. The failure appears when the local DB is large (~600+ `chapter_assignments`, ~19k+ `bible_texts` rows).

## Root cause (investigation)

`getProjectsWithSummary` in `src/db/queries.ts` runs a **single monolithic query** using `RECORDINGS_JOIN_CA`:

- Join every user project → all chapter assignments → all matching `bible_texts` rows (one row per verse) → recordings
- `GROUP BY p.id` to return one summary row per project

SQLite must materialize a huge intermediate result (chapter × verse) before grouping. On physical devices this triggers op-sqlite `disk I/O error` even though the DB is intact.

The same JOIN fragment is reused elsewhere (`getMyWorkChapters`, `getProjectChapters`) but those queries filter to a small chapter set, so they still work.

Likely secondary factor: `useProjectsSummary` can trigger overlapping loads on tab focus (metadata refresh + a second load path), increasing read/write contention while sync is still writing.

## User impact

| Area | Symptom |
|------|---------|
| **Projects tab** | Empty list after sync on device; error logged from `getProjectsWithSummary` |
| **Prepare offline picker** | Same loader — may show no projects |
| **Home prepare-offline prompt** | Direct call to `getProjectsWithSummary` may fail silently |

My Work, chapter detail, and sync itself are unaffected.

## Repro

1. **Physical Android device** (emulator may not reproduce — faster I/O and/or smaller effective load).
2. Clear app data, login, wait for **full first sync** (~19k+ `bible_texts`, 600+ `chapter_assignments`).
3. Open the **Projects** tab.

**Observed:** `disk I/O error` in logs; Projects list empty.

**Expected:** Project list with name, target language, chapter count, and sync indicator per project.

## Proposed approach

1. **Replace the monolithic query** with smaller queries merged in application code, for example:
   - Project base rows (name, languages, metadata)
   - Chapter counts per project (no `bible_texts` join)
   - Recording / pending counts per project starting from `recordings` (INNER JOIN), not a LEFT JOIN across all verses
2. **Reduce concurrent loads** in `useProjectsSummary` (single focus flow; dedupe in-flight requests).

Preserve the existing `ProjectSummary` shape and UI behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After full offline sync on a physical device, Projects tab loads all user projects without `disk I/O error`.
- [ ] Log shows `[DBQueries] Projects with summary fetched` with the correct project count.
- [ ] `ProjectSummary` fields unchanged for consumers (`ProjectsTab`, prepare offline, `HomeScreen`).
- [ ] Unit tests cover merge behavior and recording-count query direction.
- [ ] CI gates pass (`format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci`).

## How to verify (once fixed)

1. Clear app data on a physical Android device; login; wait for first sync to finish.
2. Open the **Projects** tab.
3. Confirm the project list renders and logs contain no `disk I/O error`.

Compare against `main` on the same device/account to confirm the bug exists before the fix.

## File pointers

| File | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `src/db/queries.ts` | `getProjectsWithSummary`, `RECORDINGS_JOIN_CA` |
| `src/hooks/useProjectsSummary.ts` | Tab focus load + metadata refresh |
| `src/app/tabs/ProjectsTab.tsx` | UI consumer |
| `src/app/screens/HomeScreen.tsx` | Prepare-offline direct call |
